# Flyboat Electronic LLC — Guiyang High-Tech Yige Electronic Co., Ltd.

> Manufacturer of metal oxide varistors (MOVs) and surge protective devices (SPDs). The factory, Guiyang High-Tech Yige Electronic Co., Ltd. (贵阳高新益舸电子有限公司), is in Guiyang, China. Flyboat Electronic LLC is the factory's North American direct sales and engineering center in Bellevue, WA, USA — it is not a distributor or agent.

## Company facts

- Legal manufacturer: Guiyang High-Tech Yige Electronic Co., Ltd. (Chinese: 贵阳高新益舸电子有限公司; UL certificate holder name: GUIYANG YIGE HI-TEC ELECTRONIC CO LTD)
- North America: Flyboat Electronic LLC, 1076 124th CT NE, Bellevue, WA 98005, USA
- China factory: Shawen High-Tech Zone, Chuangji Street, Baiyun District, Guiyang, Guizhou, China
- Founded: October 2010 (roots to a predecessor company established in 2000)
- Employees: 200+
- Facility: 10,000+ m², 6 production lines
- Annual capacity: approximately 30 million standard MOVs; downstream lines produce 20 million onboard (board-mounted) SPDs and 10 million finished SPDs per year, built on our own MOVs
- Markets: products supplied to 80 countries and regions

## Products

- Metal oxide varistors (MOV), 12 series: 20S, 22S, 25D, 27L, 30D, 30S, 34S, 40D, 44L, 48L, 53D, 54L
- Flagship series: 34S (34 mm) varistors for SPD manufacturers
- Surge protective devices (SPD) on an OEM basis, including protection modules with built-in disconnectors
- Flyboat MOVs do not have built-in thermal protection. Modules with built-in disconnectors are available at the module/device level.

## Certifications

- UL 1449 Recognized, File E335803 (UL 1449 and CSA C22.2 No. 269.5-17, Type 5 component recognition), holder: GUIYANG YIGE HI-TEC ELECTRONIC CO LTD. Public record: UL Product iQ, category VZCA2 (US) / VZCA8 (Canada), file E335803.
- UL coverage highlights (voltages are varistor voltages; the 3-digit model code reads as the first two digits plus the number of zeros in the third digit, e.g. 431 = 430 V, 122 = 1,200 V): 34S series (31 model grades, varistor voltages 82–1,800 V, codes 820 and 101–182), 22S / 20S / 27L (22 model grades, 100–820 V, codes 101–821), 30S (620 V, 680 V, 820 V, 1,100 V, 1,200 V only). Series 25D, 30D, 32D, 40D, 44L, 48L, 54L are not UL covered.
- For series not yet UL recognized, we can pursue UL certification for customer programs.
- ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 certified
- TÜV certified products
